scene.head: tilt
scene.placeText: the great pale-stone gate of twelve fluted columns and five passageways at the end of the linden boulevard of her world's river capital on an autumn festival night — its columns painted with slowly moving pictures of coloured light, the grand facades along the boulevard glowing the same way and crowds gathered beneath the bare linden trees
scene.ownProp: a slender crystal wand tipped with a tiny gilded linden leaf, casting a beam of coloured light
scene.outfit: a light-painter look fitted to her body — angular deep blue-black plates with sharp pointed edges shaped as a plunging bodice and a short plated skirt over bare shoulders and legs, a long cape with torn edges, every plate and the cape carrying drifting pictures of coloured light, a narrow circlet of twelve tiny fluted pale-gold columns and gold-embroidered linden leaves along the cape's hem
scene.scene: she is the light-painting mage of the festival, raising her crystal wand close beside her face to throw a new picture of coloured light onto the gate's columns, the moving colours sliding across her dark plates and torn cape as she gazes up at it

prompt:
